theater: 北希臘哈利基季亞奧林西亞

battle.name: 第一次奧林西亞戰爭
battle.theater: 北希臘哈利基季亞奧林西亞
battle.brief: 公元前382年至379年，奧林西亞率北希臘哈利基季亞城邦聯盟挑戰斯巴達霸權。斯巴達將軍歐達米達斯率兩千重裝步兵先穩住阿波羅尼亞與阿坎索斯，再圍攻奧林西亞，波利比阿德斯切斷全部補給線迫其投降。卡面的埃及月牙劍並不上陣，只能以同期的月牙小盾與色雷斯彎刀作形制對照。

kit.name: 埃及月牙劍
kit.history: 外彎的單刃劍，砍下去不用拔。它比直劍更早出現在埃及人的手上。

countries: 第一次奧林西亞戰爭是公元前382年至379年斯巴達與北希臘哈利基季亞城邦聯盟之間的戰爭，交戰地點在今希臘中馬其頓大區一帶的奧林西亞城。斯巴達一方由國王阿革西拉俄斯二世與接位的國王阿革西波利斯一世先後坐鎮，出兵由國王指派將領率領，步軍以重裝步兵中隊編制，公民兵與盟邦兵混合編組，糧秣靠伯羅奔尼撒戰爭後殘存的斯巴達同盟分擔，北方的給養線則要橫穿比奧提亞才能抵達前線。馬其頓王國站在斯巴達一邊：國王阿明塔斯三世的使者赴斯巴達陳情促成出兵，馬其頓另派步兵與騎兵配合作戰，並打算藉此收回先前被聯盟奪去的佩拉與王國北部土地。聯盟一方以奧林西亞為首都與事實上的指揮中心，公元前432年結成的聯盟在前四世紀已吞併哈利基季亞大部分城邦，採邦國聯盟的議會與將軍制運作；拒絕加入的阿波羅尼亞與阿坎索斯成為聯盟的敵對城，聯盟初時得到底比斯的援助，後因斯巴達的軍事壓力而失去這層支持。這場衝突還牽動全希臘：底比斯聯盟、雅典、科林斯與阿戈斯都在估算，奧林西亞一旦被解散，會不會輪到自己。
countriesEn: The First Olynthian War was a conflict fought from 382 to 379 BCE between Sparta and the Chalcidian League of cities in northern Greece, with the fighting centred on the city of Olynthus in what is now the region of central Macedonia. On the Spartan side the supreme authority lay with King Agesilaus II and, after him, King Agesipolis I; expeditions were commanded by generals appointed by the kings, the infantry was organised in hoplite units with citizen soldiers and allied contingents mixed together, the grain burden was shared among the rump of the Spartan alliance left over from the Peloponnesian War, and the supply line to the north had to cross Boeotia to reach the front. The Kingdom of Macedon stood on Sparta's side: the ambassadors of King Amyntas III pleaded the case in Sparta and helped bring about the intervention, Macedon supplied infantry and cavalry of its own to cooperate in the campaign, and it counted on the war to recover Pella and the northern lands of the kingdom that the League had taken. On the League's side Olynthus was the capital and in practice the command centre; the League, founded in 432 BCE, had by the early fourth century absorbed most of the cities of Chalcidice and worked as a federal polity with a council and with generals. Apollonia Mygdoniorum and Akanthos, which refused to enrol, became hostile cities of the League, and Olynthus at first had the support of Thebes before losing it under Spartan military pressure. The conflict also rippled through the whole of Greece: the Boeotian League, Athens, Corinth and Argos were all working out whether, once Olynthus had been dissolved, their own turn would come.
people: 關鍵人物集中在雙方的統帥與政治決策者。斯巴達方面，最早受命的是將軍歐達米達斯，他率兩千重裝步兵進入哈利基季亞，先把阿波羅尼亞與阿坎索斯穩在手中，再轉兵進攻奧林西亞；他沒能攻下城，攻城受挫後只能改為圍困。斯巴達的另一名將領波利比阿德斯是戰局的真正轉折點：他在公元前379年接手後不再強攻，而是切斷奧林西亞全部的補給與糧食通路，把城逼入饑餓，迫使城邦與聯盟投降。斯巴達王阿革西波利斯一世於公元前379年去世，直接改變了戰爭的時程與指揮銜接；國王阿革西拉俄斯二世其後在奧林西亞扶植新政府，又在哈利基季亞用兵時病逝，幾乎同時底比斯聯盟的武裝起義已經爆發。馬其頓王阿明塔斯三世是外交層面的關鍵人物，他派出的使者說服斯巴達出兵，自己率兵參戰，並在占領後接管哈利基季亞諸城。底比斯政府的態度轉變同樣要命：起初底比斯公開支援奧林西亞，後來在斯巴達軍隊穿越比奧提亞的壓力下改組執政，援助隨之撤回，聯盟失去最有力的外援。奧林西亞方面的將領姓名多未留下記載，但其騎兵隊在史料中特別受稱道，多次出城反擊與護送糧車。
peopleEn: The decisive personalities were the commanders and the politicians on both sides. On the Spartan side the first man sent was the general Eudamidas, who marched into Chalcidice with two thousand hoplites, first securing Apollonia and Akanthos and then turning against Olynthus; he failed to take the city by assault and could only settle down to a blockade. A second Spartan commander, Polybiades, was the true hinge of the campaign: taking over in 379 BCE he gave up the assault and instead cut every supply and provisioning line into Olynthus, starving the city into surrender and forcing the city and the League to capitulate. The death of the Spartan king Agesipolis I in 379 BCE directly reshaped the timing of the war and the chain of command. King Agesilaus II then installed a new government in Olynthus and himself died of illness while campaigning in Chalcidice, at almost exactly the moment when the Boeotian League rose in arms. Amyntas III of Macedon was the key figure at the diplomatic level: his ambassadors persuaded Sparta to intervene, he brought his own troops into the campaign, and after the victory he took over the cities of Chalcidice. The change of course in Thebes mattered just as much: Thebes at first supported Olynthus openly, then reorganised its government under the pressure of a Spartan army marching through Boeotia and withdrew that support, leaving the League without its strongest ally. The names of the Olynthian commanders are mostly lost, but their cavalry is singled out in the sources, riding out repeatedly to counter-attack and to escort supply convoys.
kits: 卡面這件埃及月牙劍屬於青銅時代的埃及：刃身外彎成新月，前緣開刃而背脊平直，砍入軟骨或皮革之後不必拔插再砍。流行期在前王朝至新王國，刃長約半米，銅質多為砷銅；到了公元前四世紀，埃及軍中早已改用直刃的塞赫佩什短劍與新式長劍，月牙劍只在神廟庫存與儀式陳列裡作為古物流存，所以它並沒有出現在奧林西亞的戰場上。真正上陣的是希臘式裝備：重裝步兵用套筒式矛頭的多利亞長矛，配直徑約九十厘米、外蒙青銅的圓盾（荷普龍），近戰用雙邊直刃短劍；聯盟的輕裝部隊以色雷斯式新月形小盾（佩爾塔）、短矛與投石索為主，投石索手是哈利基季亞人的老本行，弓手用短弓與箭，聯盟騎兵與馬其頓騎兵負責偵察、追擊與封鎖，馬匹是雙方都倚重的裝備。攻城端靠圍城、截斷糧道、撞擊槌與可移動攻城塔。卡面武器與戰場武器之間可追溯的線索是弧形刃的傳統：埃及月牙劍所代表的單面弧刃、砍入不拔的做法，與色雷斯—哈利基季亞的彎刀、新月盾同屬一個技術家族，學界對兩者是否同源仍有爭議，但它們處理砍劈任務的思路完全一致。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card belongs to Bronze Age Egypt: the blade curves forward into a crescent, edged on its leading edge with a flat back, so that once it had bitten into cartilage or hide it did not have to be pulled back out to strike again. It was in use from the Predynastic through the New Kingdom, the blade about half a metre long and usually of arsenical copper; by the fourth century BCE the Egyptian army had long since gone over to the straight sekhpesh dagger-sword and to newer blades, and the khopesh survived only in temple stores and in ritual display as an antique, so it did not appear on the battlefield of Olynthus. What actually went into the line was Greek equipment. Hoplites carried the socketed-head dory, the long spear of ash wood, and the round convex shield faced in bronze, the hoplon, roughly ninety centimetres across, with a straight double-edged sword for close work. The light troops of the League carried the Thracian-style crescent pelta, a small half-moon shield, together with short spears and slings; the slingers were a Chalcidian speciality, and the archers used short bows and arrows. League and Macedonian cavalry handled scouting, pursuit and the sealing of the roads, and horses were equipment neither side could do without. On the siege side the methods were enclosure, the cutting of supply routes, the battering ram and movable siege towers. The trace that can be followed between the card weapon and the weapons in the field is the tradition of the curved blade: the single-edged arc that bites and does not need pulling back, shown by the Egyptian khopesh, belongs to the same technical family as the Thracian-Chalcidian kopis and the crescent pelta; scholars still debate whether the two are ultimately related, but the logic with which they answer the task of chopping is identical.
tactics: 這場戰爭的戰術主軸由強攻轉為斷糧。歐達米達斯初期的部署是先取守勢，把兩千重裝步兵分置在阿波羅尼亞與阿坎索斯兩翼，確保聯盟不能從這兩座城向色雷斯的後方滲透，再集結轉向奧林西亞；斯巴達兵在盟邦引導下沿比奧提亞與馬其頓南部的道路北進，沿途靠比奧提亞境內的村鎮徵發糧秣。強攻奧林西亞失敗後，斯巴達不再往城牆上堆攻城兵力，改為封鎖全線：切斷由海路運入的物資、切斷聯盟盟邦往來的陸路輸送、把巡邏與襲擊推進到城郊，使城內的穀物、食鹽與柴薪逐步耗盡。奧林西亞守方則以騎兵維持城郊警戒與糧道護送，以輕裝步兵在城牆前列陣應對試探性攻擊，靠城牆、壕溝與有限反擊拖住斯巴達的每一次強攻。馬其頓的支援部隊在關鍵期提供了封鎖所需的機動、偵察與追擊。最後結局由補給決定：補給線被全部切斷的奧林西亞在公元前379年被迫投降，三年戰爭以封鎖奏效告終。
tacticsEn: The tactical axis of the campaign shifted from assault to starvation. Eudamidas' opening deployment was defensive: he posted his two thousand hoplites on the two wings at Apollonia and Akanthos so that the League could not infiltrate the Thracian hinterland through those two cities, and then concentrated to turn on Olynthus. The Spartan force marched north along the roads through Boeotia and southern Macedon under allied guidance, subsisting on requisitions from the villages of Boeotia on the way. After the frontal attempt on Olynthus failed, Sparta stopped piling siege troops against the walls and switched to sealing every line: cutting the supplies coming in by sea, cutting the land routes by which the League's member cities provisioned the city, and pushing patrols and raids right up to the suburbs so that the grain, salt and fuel inside were used up by degrees. The Olynthian defence answered with cavalry keeping watch on the approaches and escorting supply convoys, with light infantry drawn up in front of the wall to meet probing attacks, and with the walls, ditches and counter-strokes that held off every Spartan attempt. The Macedonian contingents supplied the mobility, reconnaissance and pursuit that the blockade required. In the end supply decided it: with every line cut, Olynthus was compelled to surrender in 379 BCE, and the three years of war were ended by the blockade rather than by the breach.
data: 可用的數字很少，而且多來自二手的古典摘要。斯巴達最初派出的部隊是歐達米達斯率領的兩千名重裝步兵，這是本役最常被引用的兵力數。聯盟成立於公元前432年，到前四世紀已控制哈利基季亞大部分城邦，並曾攻入馬其頓內陸、拿下王都佩拉；導火線是阿波羅尼亞與阿坎索斯在公元前383年向斯巴達求援。戰爭自公元前382年打到379年，史家記為三年之戰，最後以波利比阿德斯完成封鎖、聯盟投降告終。奧林西亞位於哈利基季亞西岸托羅奈灣內，距今色薩利約四十公里，距斯巴達直線約三百四十公里，斯巴達的後勤線必須橫穿比奧提亞再北上。聯盟總兵力、攻城器械數量與雙方傷亡數字在現存史料中均無可靠記載，不宜編造；可以確定的是，進攻方是以千人計的重裝步兵，而聯盟靠城防、騎兵與地形的牽制撐過數次強攻。戰後聯盟於公元前379年解散，公元前378年阿革西拉俄斯二世在哈利基季亞作戰時病逝，公元前371年留克特拉一役終結斯巴達霸權，公元前348年腓力二世攻陷奧林西亞，史稱第二次奧林西亞戰爭。
dataEn: The available numbers are few, and most of them come from secondary summaries of the classical sources. The force Sparta first sent was the two thousand hoplites led by Eudamidas, and that is the figure most often quoted for the campaign. The League was founded in 432 BCE, had by the early fourth century control over most of the cities of Chalcidice, and had pushed into the Macedonian interior far enough to take the royal capital of Pella; the trigger was the appeal to Sparta by Apollonia and Akanthos in 383 BCE. The war ran from 382 to 379 BCE, is called by historians a war of three years, and ended with Polybiades completing the blockade and the League surrendering. Olynthus lay on the western shore of the Toronean Gulf in Chalcidice, about forty kilometres from modern Thessaloniki and some three hundred and forty kilometres in a straight line from Sparta, so the Spartan supply route had to cross Boeotia and then turn north. The League's total strength, the number of siege engines and the casualty figures on both sides are not reliably recorded in the surviving sources and should not be invented; what can be said is that the attackers were hoplites numbered in the thousands, while the League, relying on its walls, its cavalry and the friction of the ground, absorbed repeated attempts to storm the city. After the war the League was dissolved in 379 BCE; Agesilaus II died of illness while campaigning in Chalcidice in 378 BCE; the battle of Leuctra in 371 BCE ended Spartan hegemony; and in 348 BCE Philip II took Olynthus, in the war now called the Second Olynthian War.
cause: 導火索是聯盟的擴張。奧林西亞主導的哈利基季亞聯盟在公元前四世紀初把勢力伸入馬其頓腹地，連王都佩拉一度落入聯盟軍隊之手；聯盟接著企圖以武力或威脅迫使拒絕加入的阿波羅尼亞與阿坎索斯屈從，以整合北岸全境。這兩座城在公元前383年向斯巴達求援，馬其頓王阿明塔斯三世的使者也赴斯巴達陳情，說明聯盟的推進已威脅到王國安全。斯巴達介入的制度性理由則來自公元前387年的安塔爾基達斯和約：和約以自治條款交換波斯撤軍，斯巴達把自治解釋為禁止任何城邦組成聯盟，據此要求解散底比斯聯盟與哈利基季亞聯盟。戰爭背後還有實質利益：哈利基季亞一帶控制北愛琴海沿岸的港口、森林與通往潘加翁山礦區的道路，是木材、銀礦與海運的關鍵；馬其頓失去這些通道，國力便難以恢復。對斯巴達而言，這是一次成本低、距離遠卻能向盟邦展示的勝利機會，用來維持科林斯戰爭後已見鬆動的同盟紀律。
causeEn: The trigger was the expansion of the League. The Chalcidian League under Olynthus pushed into the Macedonian interior in the early fourth century, at one point taking the royal capital of Pella; it then tried to force or frighten Apollonia and Akanthos, which had refused to enrol, into submission so as to integrate the whole northern coast. In 383 BCE those two cities appealed to Sparta, and the ambassadors of Amyntas III of Macedon pleaded the case in Sparta as well, pointing out that the League's advance already threatened the safety of the kingdom. Sparta's institutional reason for intervening came from the Peace of Antialcidas of 387 BCE: the peace had bought the withdrawal of the Persians in exchange for autonomy, and Sparta read that clause as forbidding any association of poleis, and on that basis demanded the dissolution of both the Boeotian League and the Chalcidian League. There were solid material interests behind the war as well: the Chalcidice area controlled the harbours, the timber and the roads to the mines of Mount Pangaion along the north Aegean, and with them the wood, silver and sea-borne trade on which the region's economy rested, while Macedon without those routes could hardly recover its strength. For Sparta the war was a cheap and distant opportunity to demonstrate power to the allies, and thereby to hold together the alliance discipline that had loosened since the Corinthian War.
impact: 戰爭的結果是北希臘的聯盟格局被重畫。哈利基季亞聯盟被解散，絕大多數城邦轉為馬其頓王阿明塔斯三世的宗主，奧林西亞則由斯巴達王阿革西拉俄斯二世扶植的政府接管。斯巴達在奧林西亞的存在象徵著它仍能以少量兵力在遠方施加影響，這是阿革西拉俄斯統治末期最成功的一次展示。但代價與後果同樣清楚：斯巴達用和約的自治條款壓制城邦聯盟的做法，把北希臘與比奧提亞的聯盟都推向反斯巴達的一邊，數年後底比斯聯盟興起，公元前371年留克特拉一役讓斯巴達的重裝步兵陣第一次在會戰中慘敗，希臘世界的主導權轉入底比斯與後來的馬其頓手中。對馬其頓而言，這是一場意外收穫：聯盟解體帶來的城邦、人口、礦產與港口，讓原本在斯巴達與底比斯之間被擠壓的王國重新站穩，也為三十年後腓力二世第二次奧林西亞戰爭直接提供了目標與藉口。對武器史而言，這場戰爭同樣標示著青銅時代的月牙劍已完全退場，前四世紀的戰場由套筒矛頭的長矛、青銅圓盾與直刃短劍主導。
impactEn: The war redrew the map of leagues in northern Greece. The Chalcidian League was dissolved; the great majority of its cities passed under the overlordship of Amyntas III of Macedon, while Olynthus itself was handed to a government installed by Agesilaus II of Sparta. The Spartan presence at Olynthus showed that Sparta could still exert influence at a distance with a small force, and it was the most successful display of Agesilaus' rule. But the costs and the consequences were equally clear. Sparta's use of the autonomy clause to suppress federations of cities pushed the leagues of the north and of Boeotia into the same anti-Spartan camp; a few years later the Boeotian League rose, and the battle of Leuctra in 371 BCE broke a Spartan hoplite army in open battle for the first time, shifting the leadership of the Greek world to Thebes and later to Macedon. For Macedon the war was an unexpected windfall: the cities, people, mines and harbours that came with the dissolution of the League let a kingdom squeezed between Sparta and Thebes stand firm again, and they gave Philip II the direct target and the pretext for the Second Olynthian War thirty years later. In the history of arms the campaign also marks the complete retirement of the Bronze Age khopesh: by the fourth century BCE the battlefield was governed by socketed spear-heads, bronze-faced round shields and straight swords.
result: 結果是斯巴達一方在公元前379年獲勝，但勝利靠的是封鎖而不是強攻。波利比阿德斯切斷奧林西亞全部補給線之後，城內糧食耗盡，奧林西亞與聯盟在三年戰爭後被迫投降，城邦聯盟隨即解散，諸城歸馬其頓宗主，奧林西亞換上斯巴達扶持的政府。斯巴達的霸權看似完好：國王阿革西拉俄斯二世在奧林西亞扶植政權，又在哈利基季亞用兵，公元前378年病逝當地。然而就在同一年，底比斯聯盟的武裝起義開始，公元前371年留克特拉的一場會戰便讓這套霸權體系崩解，斯巴達再也沒有恢復對北希臘的支配。聯盟解散之後，奧林西亞人還有另一條更殘酷的出路：公元前348年馬其頓王腓力二世率軍攻入奧林西亞，破城之後把大批居民賣為奴隸，史稱第二次奧林西亞戰爭。奧林西亞從此在史冊上消失，只留下斯巴達王留下的一次短暫插曲，以及後世斷續拼湊的考古碎片。
resultEn: The result was a Spartan victory in 379 BCE, but a victory won by blockade rather than by assault. Once Polybiades had cut every supply line into Olynthus, the grain inside the city ran out, and after three years of war Olynthus and the League were compelled to surrender: the confederation was dissolved at once, the cities passed under Macedonian overlordship, and Olynthus was given a government kept in place by Sparta. Spartan hegemony looked intact. King Agesilaus II installed the new regime in Olynthus and campaigned in Chalcidice himself, dying there of illness in 378 BCE. Yet in that same year the Boeotian League rose in arms, and a single battle at Leuctra in 371 BCE brought the whole hegemonic structure down; Sparta never recovered its grip on the north. After the League was dissolved the Olynthians had yet another and far more brutal way out: in 348 BCE Philip II of Macedon marched into Olynthus, broke the city and sold large numbers of its inhabitants into slavery, in the war now called the Second Olynthian War. Olynthus disappeared from the historical record, leaving behind only the brief episode staged by a Spartan king and the fragments of archaeology that later generations pieced together.
